text: Replace proof-by-tool-execution with proof-carrying patches whose generated derivations are checked by one tiny trusted kernel.
rationale: The expensive battery becomes a producer of reusable formal obligations while acceptance reduces to validating a compact certificate.

text: Make the coding agent emit changes through a schema-and-law-constrained AST protocol that cannot represent architecture-illegal programs.
rationale: Checks move inside generation, turning whole classes of lint, boundary, documentation, and modeling failures into impossible output states.

text: Turn main into an append-only commit ledger with a computed green projection that automatically excludes incompatible squash commits until repaired.
rationale: Integration never blocks on preserving a physically green branch because consumers resolve the maximal compatible projection.

text: Dissolve the monorepo tree into immutable package capsules and make each PR a transactional rewrite of a signed dependency manifest.
rationale: Validation targets independently promotable package worlds instead of repeatedly reconstructing one 129-package checkout.

text: Merge every candidate immediately into an isolated shadow-main lineage and define correctness as surviving continuous mutation, replay, and automatic rollback.
rationale: Pre-merge gates disappear in favor of many disposable futures where regressions identify and eject their introducing lineage.

text: Certify the agent's research-to-probe-to-ship trace instead of its final diff, accepting only transformations whose evidence chain closes every declared obligation.
rationale: CI becomes a verifier of provenance and justified decisions, with tool reruns reserved for adversarial audits rather than every PR.
